clues.title: Google car: Silver car
text: If you have vibes/other clues that you are in the middle east and you have silver car in Gen3 that means you can only be in UAE.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Road line: Roadlines
text: Outer roadlines are yellow, middle lines are white.
They can also be full yellow.
**NOTE:** Other Middle Eastern countries, like Jordan, Israel and Oman, also use these lines.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Gulf of Oman
text: If you see mountains to the west, and flatness to the east, you are likely near the Gulf of Oman, in the extreme East of the country.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Northern Mountains
text: You can easily recognise the Northern part of the emirate of Ras al Khaimah thanks to the light-coloured mountains visible to the east.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Mountains
text: Mountains are only found in the far east of the country.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Google car: Gen 3 Car
text: In almost all Generation 3 coverage, a white car with visible black roof racks was used.
The UAE is the only Middle Eastern country where a white Google car can be found.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Unpaved Roads
text: Although the UAE is a wealthy country, it is not uncommon for residential roads to be unpaved.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Google car: Gen 4 Truck
text: In Generation 4 coverage, a white pickup truck with a trekker camera was used for much of the coverage.
In a lot of the coverage, the truck is completely blurred out.
A similar truck can be found in Qatar and Oman.
In the UAE the antenna at the front of the cabin is on the middle of the car, while in Qatar it is on the left.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Landscape
text: The UAE typically features a flat desert landscape.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Architecture: Reddish Sidewalks
text: Houses in residential areas are typically made of light-coloured stone.
Reddish stones are often used for sidewalks.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Pole: Poles
text: Electricity poles in the UAE are mostly made of dark brown wood.
The pole tops consist of three insulators, symmetrically attached to a horizontal metal bar.
Similar poletops can be found in Oman.
Jordanian poletops may look similar, but they are usually made of grey concrete, and the insulators are more spaced out.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Google car: Gen 4 Black Car
text: You can also find regular Generation 4 coverage taken with a black car.
The brake light is commonly visible.
A similar Generation 4 black car can be found in Israel.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Curbs
text: Similarly, almost all curbs are striped.
They can be either black-and-white, or black-and-yellow.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
